<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M peak with decreasing M+1, M+2, etc., matching the expected carbon 13C distribution and lacking the characteristic 2 Da spacing or larger M+2 intensities of Cl, Br, or S—the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
